description: Closed hi-hat built by modelling an analogue circuit, running from noise through to a ringing metallic cymbal

params.text: How metallic the cymbal is: at 0% it is close to noise, at 100% resonant and ringing
Click to sound the closed hi-hat once
How strongly an accent changes the hit

inputs.text: A trigger here sounds the closed hi-hat
Modulates how metallic the cymbal is
A voltage here accents the hit as it is triggered; on some drums that means more level, on others a sharper transient with more harmonics
A trigger here chokes the closed hi-hat; patching the open hi-hat's gate in keeps the two from sounding at once
CV over the attack and the decay of the cymbal envelope

notes: there is no sequencer or clock here; the drum sounds once for each trigger patched in, or each click on its button
